build.command: cmake --build build/a2a-native --config Release --target xmind_server xmind_cli xmind_admin agentflow_a2a_client_sdk_contract agentflow_a2a_agent_registry_contract --parallel 8

verified: The native outbound client interoperated with the independent official A2A SDK 1.3.0 server for authenticated AgentCard discovery, SendMessage, GetTask, text artifact retrieval, wrapped SendStreamingMessage events, and CancelTask.
The official SDK client exercised xMind's inbound A2A 1.0 server, including task history, streaming, listing/cancellation, persistence across SQLite restart, and legacy 0.3 wire coverage.
The registered remote-agent contract exercised native discovery, durable approval binding, streaming event journaling, denial without dispatch, and post-dispatch uncertainty recovery without replay.
limitations: Provider and peer task behavior are test fixtures; no live external agent or model was used.
The selected JSON-RPC cases do not establish every A2A transport, security scheme, content type, artifact mode, or rendered CLI/webpage/VS Code workflow.
